guide.overview: A powerful **single-target physical burst** specialist, Blue Beetle absorbs allies' **[Scarab Sigil]** effects to power up **[Scarab Judgment]**, delivering a massive single-target hit that ignores [Shields]. His Sigils also boost [Teen Titans] and [Justice League] allies.

legacyPieces.name: Scarab Buster
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts other allies' Attack at the start of battle and increases Blue Beetle's Ultimate and skill damage. Whenever your squad defeats an enemy, Blue Beetle gains Energy, while other [Teen Titans] or [Justice League] allies also gain extra Energy, subject to a cooldown.

legacyPieces.name: Tectonic Disruptor
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Crit Rate and lets [Scarab Judgment] inflict [Severe Wound], helping Blue Beetle finish off enemies with his Ultimate.

legacyPieces.name: Cold Gun
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Attack and Accuracy, helping Blue Beetle land his single-target [Plasma Pulse] and [Scarab Judgment] attacks.

legacyPieces.name: Replica Time Commander
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Attack to strengthen Blue Beetle's physical damage and Ultimate burst.
